title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: When you one-hot encode a categorical variable, each category becomes a separate column. For example, if you one-hot encode the 'sex' column, you will have two new columns: one for 'male' and one for 'female'.

title: Columns in the Design Matrix
text: Consider how many unique values are in the 'sex' and $$'embark_{town'}$$ columns. Each unique value will become a separate column in the design matrix after one-hot encoding.

title: Counting Unique Values
text: How many unique values are there in the $$'embark_{town'}$$ column?

title: Invertibility of a Matrix
text: A matrix is invertible if it is square and has full rank. Consider the dimensions of $$\Phi_3$$ and what it means for $${\Phi_3}^T \Phi_3$$ to be invertible.

hintAnswer: The columns must be linearly independent.
title: Checking Full Rank
text: What condition must be met for a matrix to have full rank?
choices: The columns must be linearly independent.
The rows must be linearly dependent.
